description: Principal owns the target object and can rewrite its DACL at will.

telemetry.detail: Any DACL rewrite performed via ownership is logged under DS-change auditing.
Same grant-then-use behavioural pattern as WriteOwner/WriteDacl.

abuse_primitive: Owner rewrites DACL to grant full control, then abuses.
notes: Treated near WriteOwner. The abuse action selected downstream sets the true cost.
